_comment: Usage drivers for the Sound Along cost model. Every number here is an input to scripts/estimate_cost.py; edit and re-run. 'src' notes where a value comes from: a repo file, a measured sample, or ASSUMPTION (a guess to confirm with the team).

catalog.src: docs/SoundAlong-Kiro.md Context + Constraints (6,893 passages, ~20M chars, 64% computerized / 36% human audio). spanish_extra_chars: ASSUMPTION, set >0 if ES versions are generated on top of the 20M.

media.src: Measured from frontend/public/sa e1p1 sample: 354 chars -> 123,020 B MP3, 20,495 ms, 297 B timing.gz, 3,247 B product JSON.

current.src: etl/voices.json (neural, 2 tracks per lang) + etl/audio.py (MP3 call + speech-marks call, both billed)

target.src: docs/SoundAlong-Kiro.md US-3 (generative, one voice per language); timing from WhisperX, so no speech-marks call

churn.src: ASSUMPTION: share of the catalog edited and regenerated per month after backfill (textHash skip means unchanged passages cost nothing).

traffic.src: weekly_plays: docs/BB-vision-document (1,818,026 presses of play per week, 888,147 weekly audio students). Current deploy: CloudFront does not cache index.html or sa/ (CACHING_DISABLED), so every play also passes through the NLB. Others ASSUMPTION: full MP3 downloaded per play, ~50 KB uncached app assets, 5 CDN requests (JSON, timing, MP3 ranges, app).

api_current.src: ASSUMPTION: ad-hoc POST /api/v1/text-to-speech usage. Default track only = 2 Polly calls per request (lambda/text_to_speech_post/handler.py).

lambda_target._per_passage: memory MB and duration ms for each pipeline Lambda, per passage
lambda_target.src: ASSUMPTION: architecture table in docs/SoundAlong-Kiro.md; durations not measured yet.

stepfunctions.src: ASSUMPTION: Standard workflow; tokenize, synth start, wait/poll loop, align, QA, stops, write, plus retries.

fargate.src: ASSUMPTION: WhisperX on CPU Fargate at ~1x audio length plus 60 s task start + model load. Phase 0 spike (task 0.4) should measure this.

bedrock.src: ASSUMPTION: ~4 tagged vocab per passage (etl/inputs/e1.vocab.json has 4); model not chosen yet, priced as Claude Haiku 4.5 (see prices.json).

ec2.src: docs/SoundAlong-Kiro.md Components: 'EC2 (small), Node 18 + Express 4' content API.

observability.src: current CDK sets no log retention (never expire); 12 = storage after one year. Target assumes 30-day retention. Alarm/dashboard counts ASSUMPTION.

security.src: storage-stack.ts (1 CMK). Secrets Manager / GuardDuty from Security baseline in docs/SoundAlong-Kiro.md. GuardDuty is a flat ASSUMPTION; its price depends on CloudTrail/S3 event volume.

analytics.src: Phase 4 task 4.5 (Firehose -> S3 -> Athena). Event counts ASSUMPTION.

cicd.src: docs/pipeline-setup.md (CodePipeline V2 + CodeBuild). Build counts ASSUMPTION.

eks_current.src: infra/cdk/lib/frontend-stack.ts: EKS 1.35, 1x t3.medium managed node (20 GB), 1 NAT gateway, internet-facing NLB in 2 AZs (NAT EIP + 2 NLB IPs), 2 pods each syncing sa/ from S3 through the NAT.

etl_lambda_current.src: lambda-readworks-bb-dev-etl-run REPORT lines: ~2.5 s billed for ~400-char passages (2 tracks). 5 s assumed for the ~2,900-char average.
